create_sequential_orchestrator: create a SequentialOrchestrator with a list of agent IDs to define interaction order
init_orchestrator: initialize an Orchestrator with simulation ID, first agent, sink, metadata, and resources
update_orchestrator: update the orchestrator with an agent result and advance to the next agent in sequence
cleanup_orchestrator: cleanup an orchestrator by releasing resources, unregistering task refs, and clearing history
check_orchestrator_status: check if an orchestrator is done, successful, or in error state using is_done and is_success
